caption:
Anthropic is testing an unnamed model that can work out what users really want from short instructions, The Information reports.
Google is preparing Gemini 4 Carbon, and OpenAI a cheaper Terra model that could arrive in the coming weeks.
None of the three companies has announced a date.

Which lab ships first?

slides.headline: Anthropic's unreleased model reportedly *figures out what you really want*, even when you don't say it

slides.heading: A model with *intuition*
paras: Anthropic is developing a model with stronger reasoning and what The Information calls intuition: it can infer a user's real goal from limited instructions.
One tester said it spots the bigger problem behind a single software bug and proposes a more complete fix.

slides.heading: Google and OpenAI *answer back*
paras: Google is preparing Gemini 4 Carbon, an upgrade to Gemini 4 Argon. Developers say Gemini is especially strong at visual tasks like video analysis.
OpenAI is working on a new Terra model, possibly out in the coming weeks, with better skills at a lower price than GPT-6.1 Sol.

slides.hook: Three labs, three new models on the way. Follow so you know the moment one drops.
